description: Destroy one of the organization's own skills. It leaves list_skills, and its name is free for create_skill. Agents that pinned one of its versions keep resolving that version. Refuses while any agent has the skill attached and names those agents; detach it from each with detach_skill first. Destroying a well-known name such as governance or design-system brings back Valet's default for every agent in the organization. A skill that does not exist is reported as already gone. Requires connecting a Valet account.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

skill.description: Required. The skill's name, as list_skills reports it.

name: destroy_skill
title: Destroy an organization skill
